essence: The supreme being encompasses multiple deities and elemental cosmic forces.
The supreme being is both the radiant source of illumination and the ultimate ground of all praise.
The supreme being embodies healing, well-being, auspiciousness, and supreme capability.
The supreme being unites creative vitality, health, wisdom, kinship, and greatness.
The supreme being combines universal benevolence and endurance with the power to ward off all hostility.
